Implementation/evidence gate: R24 untethered USB-C operation operator reported; protected battery source qualification pending

Requirement Description: Capture room speech and environmental sound through microphone and output it
Black-box acceptance evidence: Document near and distant speech pickup and ambient input with the bench output fixture
Implementation/evidence gate: R24 microphone worked; R26 distant speech and ambient output not physically measured

Requirement Description: Play Bluetooth audio and tolerate interruption and reconnection
Black-box acceptance evidence: Pair or reconnect, play, pause and recover without reflashing
Implementation/evidence gate: R24 Bluetooth worked; repeatable reconnect observations pending

Requirement Description: Reproduce induction-loop signals with controlled idle noise
Black-box acceptance evidence: 2 kHz TC reception, deliberate signal interruption and idle hiss comparison
Implementation/evidence gate: LOW16 plus FILTER ON operator verified; residual noise and R26 adaptation unverified

Requirement Description: Operate touch source selection, mute and rotary volume reliably

Implementation/evidence gate: R24 touch and encoder operator reported working; repetition test pending

Requirement Description: Apply bounded adaptive gain without uncontrolled output distortion

Requirement Description: Handle abnormal source and control order and recover without reflash
Black-box acceptance evidence: Rapid E8 to E11 transitions and interruption or power-cycle recovery
Implementation/evidence gate: On-target fault-recovery timing and queue behaviour pending

Requirement Description: Demonstrate adaptive control or interference rejection on real input
Black-box acceptance evidence: Repeatable quiet/loud stimulus input change and observable response
Implementation/evidence gate: R26 unsupervised three-centroid DSP candidate; no supervised event labels

Requirement Description: Maintain stable continuous operation under expected input conditions
